description: Personal data, confidential records, classified documents, and operationally sensitive information must never be submitted to public AI tools.
risk_indicators: Contains names of real individuals; includes financial figures; references restricted operations; involves identifiable participants
mitigation: Use only dummy data or public documents; apply data minimisation; review before submission
example_scenario: Uploading anonymised training notes vs uploading an actual personnel record

description: AI-generated content may contain hallucinations — plausible but incorrect facts, figures, names, or dates — that require human verification.
risk_indicators: Content includes specific statistics; cites sources; contains names or dates; makes strong assertions
mitigation: Cross-check key facts with authoritative sources; mark uncertain points explicitly; require a verification checklist
example_scenario: AI-generated budget note containing invented figures presented as facts

description: AI should support analysis and drafting. Official decisions, approvals, and accountable actions must be taken by a qualified human, not by AI output alone.
risk_indicators: Prompt asks AI to make a final decision; output is used without review; accountability is unclear
mitigation: Use AI for draft and options only; require named human reviewer and approver; document the review
example_scenario: Using an AI-generated recommendation as the final official decision without verification

description: Provide only the information needed for the task. Avoid uploading entire documents when only a section is relevant.
risk_indicators: Full document uploaded when a summary would suffice; excess personal context included; unnecessary background data shared
mitigation: Extract only the relevant section before submission; anonymise where possible; apply need-to-know principle
example_scenario: Copying an entire 50-page policy document when only the relevant clause is needed

description: When AI is used in a significant decision-making process, record what was used, how, and who reviewed the output.
risk_indicators: No record of AI use; reviewer is unnamed; version of output used is unclear
mitigation: Maintain a simple log of AI use: tool used
column11: Using an AI-drafted brief in a committee meeting without noting that it was AI-assisted

rule_title: Monitor for bias in AI outputs
description: AI models may reflect biases present in training data. Outputs involving people, groups, or comparative evaluations need extra scrutiny.
risk_indicators: Output refers to demographic groups; evaluates individuals; makes comparative assessments; uses stereotyped language
mitigation: Apply an explicit bias review checklist; involve diverse reviewers; avoid demographic profiling in prompts
example_scenario: AI-generated recruitment criteria that inadvertently favour one profile over another

description: When AI has contributed to a document or decision, the appropriate parties should be aware. Concealment undermines trust and accountability.
risk_indicators: AI-assisted content presented as entirely human-authored; no disclosure to reviewers or approvers
mitigation: Disclose AI assistance in the document or covering note; identify which sections are AI-supported vs human-authored
example_scenario: Submitting an AI-drafted policy note to a committee without disclosing the AI contribution

rule_title: Maintain critical evaluation of AI outputs
description: AI outputs that are fluent and well-formatted can create false confidence. Quality of presentation is not proof of quality of content.
risk_indicators: Output is accepted without review due to professional appearance; AI confidence is mistaken for accuracy
mitigation: Apply a structured review checklist regardless of output quality; treat AI output as a first draft only
example_scenario: Accepting an AI summary of a legal document without reading the source

rule_title: Respect source material and intellectual property
description: AI-generated content that paraphrases or reproduces third-party content without attribution may create copyright or intellectual property issues.
risk_indicators: Output closely echoes a specific source document; reproduces lengthy passages; lacks attribution
mitigation: Request source references where available; verify that reproduced text is not from a protected source
example_scenario: AI generating a training module that closely mirrors a commercial training provider's materials

rule_title: Avoid AI in high-stakes irreversible decisions
description: AI should not be used to support decisions that are irreversible, involve significant individual rights, or have major legal or financial consequences without substantial human safeguards.
risk_indicators: Decision is irreversible; involves individual rights or employment; has legal or financial consequences above defined thresholds
mitigation: Apply enhanced review; involve subject-matter experts; escalate to senior leadership for final approval
example_scenario: Using AI to screen candidates and rejecting applicants without human review
